methodology: Local, read-only review of every canonical record, every stored qualification summary and all 156 stored evidence summaries. No fresh web verification was performed. Source claims are treated as previously recorded claims, not newly confirmed facts. Original worker records were consulted for urCASH and Zakn; no canonical data was modified. The coordinator additionally reported a live BookMyGuide founder-post recheck on 2026-09-05; that finding is explicitly attributed below.
target: Saudi-market buyer with a specific unbuilt core software product and no more than two current hands-on software builders, including co-founders and contractors. Public/production software already operating is outside the target. Company operation, a website, a total-employee band, a private-alpha label or silence about developers cannot decide eligibility alone.
interpretation: These verdicts are recommendations, not a migration of the canonical list. An exclusion based on an already-built product does not claim three or more engineers.
All 50 rows lack a complete current software-role census and upper bound. A visible role is a lower bound; absence of names, total employee bands and job vacancies do not prove a zero-to-two maximum.

Five records have the clearest historical pre-build signals: urCASH, Vision Mate, Wathba, Jadi and BookMyGuide. Each needs current product, team and paid-budget verification. BookMyGuide is low-priority because the coordinator's live recheck establishes planned Saudi entry, not confirmed current Saudi activity.

The other seven holds are Smart Quotation, Gaia, Zakn, Ballora, GreenVision, Suhail and Mara. Program participation, private access, an MVP label or a prototype demo does not settle current product operation.
Every SME-lane row describes an existing software offering or deployment in its actual evidence/qualification narrative. None was excluded merely because the company lifecycle says operating.
Repeated observed_at=2026-09-03 says when research was recorded; it does not refresh a 2025 or undated source. Store trigger date separately, preserve approximate age/range and source-date certainty.

Two URLs are not automatically two independent sources: founder profile, company page and founder-authored job post are typically one source group, while a mirrored job repeats the same underlying claim.

Recruiting a salaried engineer, recruiting an equity co-founder and procuring paid development are different intentions. The first two can identify a build gap without proving software-service buying intent.
Current point arithmetic may add correctly while the narrative fails the rubric. Validation should test eligibility and claim-to-rule mapping, not only numeric bounds and sums.
